page0.text: Then, if I pull out this nail stabbing my right arm...!

page1.text:
I throw away my weapon and reach towards the dagger in my right arm.
"...You are brave. Though you always pick the path of pain."
But to her, everything I do must be as slow as molasses.
The Servant in black thrusts her nail towards me to pierce my left hand as well...!

page2.text:
"Khh...!"
I desperately swing my body to avoid it, but it's no use.
The Servant mercilessly thrusts the nail towards me right before my eyes.
She is shot from the side by numerous light bullets.

page3.text:
"Augh...!"
I fall to the ground.
The bullet cuts the chain, and I am unceremoniously dropped on my ass.
